mode: upstream-frontend + 极客班论坛 site build on the forum server (/api/forum) + local read-only snapshot adapter

modifiedUpstreamFiles.nuxt.config.ts: Inject public environment/version metadata from the root declarative domain contract; contentSource/siteName/loginMode come from shared/content-source.ts (GEEK_FORUM_SOURCE=site: 极客班论坛 with its own categories and tags plus the old-forum documents published in content/published, and no content directory, which is how the images are built; GEEK_FORUM_SOURCE=demo: the upstream seed; unset: the snapshot when GEEK_FORUM_CONTENT_DIR is set, the seed otherwise; loginMode is site unless GEEK_FORUM_LOGIN=demo on the demo seed); set app.baseURL from GEEK_FORUM_BASE_PATH so the static build can be served under the portal domain /forum path; prerender /llms.txt and /t/<id>.md for every seed topic (for 极客班论坛, every published topic from shared/published.ts; answered by server/middleware/forum-markdown.ts) so the static build ships them as files, and publish that topic list as runtime public markdownTopicIds; define the build-time constant import.meta.env.GEEK_FORUM_SITE so a site build leaves the demo seed out of the browser bundle; no static head title. Local is not preview, and metadata does not authorize deployment. Dev only: nitro.devProxy forwards /auth, /api/public/org and /api/forum to the local core server (127.0.0.1:3000) with Origin set to the portal origin 127.0.0.1:5173, so the forum dev server can read the site-wide session, sign out through the core Origin check and read the 称号/部门 display data for TitleBadge, and read and write 极客班论坛 through the forum server; not part of the static build (online the forum shares the core origin).
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/about.vue: Show the owner's preview/production domains and environment/version card (DeploymentInfo: preview is released by a vX.Y.Z-rc.N tag on a stage commit and shows X.Y.Z-rc.N@<sha12>; production by vX.Y.Z on the same commit and shows X.Y.Z; pushing a branch releases nothing); describe 极客班论坛 in a site build with the same current-state sentences as the banner and llms.txt (shared/site-notice.ts: part of the old forum is published here; anyone can read and reply under a nickname, starting topics, likes, bookmarks and follows need the GitHub sign-in, only 极客班 members can sign in); one line credits the open-source Tuff Forum, talex-touch/tuff-forum, MIT) without the stats and staff cards, which would be empty; describe the 极客班 read-only snapshot when it is the content source, upstream demo text otherwise. The heading spaces the site name like Chinese text does (关于 Tuff Forum, 关于极客班论坛; shared/content-source.ts siteNameInText).
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/categories.vue: Category rows show both cues: category.icon as the TxCardItem icon-class avatar and upstream's TxBadge colour dot in front of the name (title slot), so the upstream 8-dot assertion holds; rows carry role=link; recent-topic TxCellLink hrefs carry app.baseURL. With no topics (a 极客班论坛 build) the desktop 最新 card shows a small 还没有话题 / 极客班成员登录后可以发第一个话题。 empty state, and a category row without recent topics drops the empty link list under it.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/c/[slug].vue: Banner keeps upstream TxCardItem + TxStatCard but lays them out with TxFlex: heading beside a two-column TxGrid of stats, wrapping under it on a phone (upstream's #right slot stacked the full-width stat cards into a tall column); the category name is the page h1.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/tag/[slug].vue: Banner keeps upstream TxCardItem + TxStatCard but lays them out with TxFlex: heading beside a two-column TxGrid of stats, wrapping under it on a phone (upstream's #right slot stacked the full-width stat cards into a tall column); the tag is the page h1.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/users.vue: The member TxCellLink href carries app.baseURL (useAppLink); the 角色 cell shows the 极客班 TitleBadge when the user has a title (the forum role badge otherwise), sorts by titleRank (fixed in code: 提督 0 … no title 9) then role rank, and is widened to fit 「社区部 · 队长」. The header text stays 角色 because the upstream directory check asserts it. With no users at all (a 极客班论坛 build) the directory shows 还没有用户 / 成员登录过论坛后会出现在这里。 instead of the filter-miss message. Guests of 极客班论坛 (kind: 'guest', one per nickname reply) are left out of the directory.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/layouts/default.vue: Wrap the page area in LocalSnapshotGate; the LoginModal comment describes both login modes; no business rewrite.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/app.vue: Site name from the content source in the title template; the /new command is hidden under the site-wide login unless the viewer may create a topic (a signed-in member of 极客班论坛; never in the read-only snapshot); in a site build the /about command reads 论坛简介, because that page has no staff card.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/error.vue: Site name from the content source in the error page title template.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/plugins/persist.client.ts: Skip localStorage hydration and writes entirely in snapshot mode so the real archive never lands in the demo storage, in a 极客班论坛 site build so demo posts stored in this browser can never pass as forum content, and under the site-wide login so a stored mock identity can never pass as signed in.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/ForumHeader.vue: Site name from content source; the official 极客班 logo (/logo.png, decorative, accessible name = visible site name) replaces TxTuffLogoStroke in front of it (owner 2026-09-25, #62: the stroke logo read as a blurry dot and the logo belongs in the header, not a sidebar card). The demo user menu starts with a disabled 「@<handle> · <role>」 row, because the sidebar no longer shows the signed-in account. Under the site-wide login the forum has no login of its own: the header reads /auth/me; signed in shows the avatar menu (AccountMenu.vue, rows from app/data/account-menu.ts: a 昵称/@login header row, then 我的主页, 账号资料, 我的书签, 通知, 控制台 only when /auth/me returns console_link: true, 返回宣传主页, 查看环境与版本, 退出, each with an i-carbon icon; no TxDivider, which kept its 16px page margins inside the menu panel and read as an empty row) and the notification bell for a signed-in 极客班论坛 member; signed out shows a single 用 GitHub 登录 button (登录 on narrow screens, same accessible name) that goes to /auth/github with return_to back to the current forum page including query and hash; in dev the login and 控制台 go through the portal origin 127.0.0.1:5173. Login mode is separate from the content source (runtime public loginMode): the site-wide GitHub login is the default for every build, including the deployed 极客班论坛 (site) images; only scripts/forum.mjs sets GEEK_FORUM_LOGIN=demo for the upstream CDP suites and the local sample preview, which keep the upstream mock login unchanged.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/ForumSidebar.vue: No workspace card and no footer account card (owner 2026-09-25, #62): TxSidebarNav gets no workspace prop, so the filter field is the first row; the 极客班 logo and site name live in ForumHeader, the account only in its avatar menu. Fine-tuned font sizes; category rows show the category icon with upstream's TxBadge colour dot on its corner (both cues, upstream dot assertion intact). The footer only exists outside the site-wide login and holds 重置示例数据 alone (the demo 登录 button is in the header); under the site-wide login nothing is kept in this browser, so there is no footer.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/composables/useForumNav.ts: Pass category.icon to sidebar nav items; the sidebar pairs that icon with upstream's dotColors colour dot. Under the site-wide login someone not signed in also gets 返回宣传主页 in 社区 (members find it in the avatar menu); selecting it leaves the forum for the portal.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/LoginModal.vue: The mock member picker renders only in the demo login mode. Under the site-wide login nothing is rendered (no in-forum login); a login-required action (赞, 书签, 关注, 新话题) that opens loginOpen gets a Tuffex toast instead: in 极客班论坛 a 登录后才能继续 toast whose 登录 action goes to the site-wide GitHub sign-in, or, from data/access.ts UNAVAILABLE_COPY, 论坛服务暂时连不上 when the forum server did not answer, 请求太频繁，稍后再试 while it answers 429, and 这个账号现在不能在论坛里发帖 for someone signed in site-wide whom the server serves as a guest (no longer in the organization); in the read-only snapshot a short note that posting and reactions are not open yet. No click goes unanswered. The toast's words come from data/access.ts loginPromptToast (unit-tested); the modal only adds the 登录 action.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/PostCard.vue: The body renders through ForumMarkdown (shared/post-markdown.ts: raw HTML shown as text, link and image addresses limited to http(s), mailto and site paths, then TxMarkdownView's DOMPurify) inside an overflow container for mobile table/code scrolling; the copied permalink and the author TxCellLink href carry app.baseURL (useAppLink); the author row shows the 极客班 TitleBadge when the author has a title, 游客 (plain secondary text, not a badge) for a guest of 极客班论坛, the upstream role badge otherwise. Editing uses PostEditor instead of TxMarkdownEditor (编辑 / 分栏 / 预览, the preview through ForumMarkdown): the post goes into its textarea as written and the draft is saved as typed. Like, bookmark, edit and delete go through useForumActions (the forum server in a site build); against the server they show at once and the server store puts the post back with a toast on a refusal (#145): the bookmark and delete toasts follow the post as it now shows, the editor closes on the new text and reopens on the draft when the edit is refused, and 帖子已更新 waits for the server; a reply still being sent (a pending id) says 发送中 with aria-busy and shows none of 赞, 链接, 书签, 编辑, 删除 or 回复 until the server's post replaces it; a guest of 极客班论坛 gets the per-post 回复 button too. The like button (#143) is no longer a bare heart with a count and aria-label="赞": it is a flat TxButton (regular text and border, like the 链接 button beside it) whose text is 「赞 N」 (「赞」 with no likes) and names it (no aria-label), with the heart filled and the danger tone (type="danger") once the viewer has liked the post (data/likes.ts likeControl), aria-pressed kept; a click from someone who may not like opens loginOpen, anyone else's goes to useForumActions().toggleLike as before.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/TopicControls.vue: The blocked state follows useCurrentUser().access: the demo keeps its 登录 prompt; 极客班论坛 lets a guest use the bar (回复 as a guest, 分享; 书签 asks to sign in; no notification level) and says 论坛服务暂时连不上 when the forum server did not answer or 请求太频繁，稍后再试 while it answers 429 (data/access.ts UNAVAILABLE_COPY); the read-only snapshot says replies and reactions are not open yet. Bookmarking goes through useForumActions and its toast follows the bookmark as it now shows (at once against the forum server, #145); the share link carries app.baseURL (useAppLink).
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/UserAvatar.vue: Pass the optional avatarUrl (local asset route) to TxAvatar; initials stay the fallback.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/data/types.ts: Optional User.avatarUrl (the forum server's uploaded or GitHub avatar, or a snapshot avatar; the seed never sets it), optional User.title (极客班 称号, see app/data/titles.ts) and optional User.kind (member / guest / official, set by the forum server); role semantics unchanged. ForumChanges is the shape of a forum server write's answer (#145).
modifiedUpstreamFiles.uno.config.ts: Safelist the category icons that arrive as snapshot/curation data (the scanner cannot see them) and re-run the config when content/curation.json changes.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.scripts/lib/cdp.mjs: Configurable Chromium executable, unique temporary profiles, own-process-group cleanup instead of broad pkill. Original assertions remain intact.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/u/[username]/index.vue: Profile banner shows the 极客班 TitleBadge (size md) beside the name, in addition to the unchanged forum-role badge, and 游客 as plain text for a guest of 极客班论坛 (no 关注 button on a guest); the 个人签名 (bio) keeps its line breaks (whitespace-pre-line); the website becomes a link only when it is https:// (linkableWebsite), for the href and for window.open. Following goes through useForumActions. The 偏好设置 tab note names 昵称 and 个人签名.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/data/seed-content.ts: UserSeed.title and the demo 极客班 titles: talex 舰长, mika 社区部 · 队长, yuki 技术部 · 队长, kai 技术部 · 舰员, lin 领航员, six plain members; bruce none. No role changed, so the one-admin/one-moderator seed test and the upstream suites' author/other members (ryan, xiaoyu) are unaffected. Three seed bodies say the same thing without the → arrow character (the owner bans decorative arrows); no topic, title, count or reply changes.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/data/seed.ts: buildUsers copies the optional seed title onto the user (a fresh object per user); consumes no PRNG draws, so every other seeded value is unchanged.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/data/permissions.ts: Adds hasForumCapability(user, capability): admin/moderator by role hold every forum capability as before, anyone else holds what their 极客班 title carries (titleForumCapabilities: the forum part of the server's default title packs (ROLE_BASE: 提督 and 舰长 everything) plus the default department packs). These packs stay local defaults: the server publishes no permission packs to the forum (GET /api/public/org carries display data only), so a pack the 提督 edits in the console does not reach the forum until its backend exists (#57). isStaff = forum.post.moderate (edit/delete others' posts, reply in closed topics); pinTopic reads forum.topic.pin and closeTopic reads forum.topic.close. Demo permissions only, not an authorization boundary; every other ForumAction rule is unchanged. Against the forum server the callers pass the viewer's capabilities from /api/forum/state (GrantedCapabilities) and that set is the only answer, so a title or role on the user object grants nothing by itself; a guest account (kind: 'guest') can do nothing through can().
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/t/[id].vue: The 话题管理 menu shows when the viewer may pin or close (can('pinTopic') / can('closeTopic')) instead of isStaff, and lists only the items they may use, so a title that carries forum.topic.pin alone (项目部 head) sees 置顶话题 without 关闭话题. Admins and moderators still get both items; the upstream staff pin check is unchanged. Add <link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown"> to the topic head, only for topics that have a Markdown file (runtime public markdownTopicIds from nuxt.config.ts: the seed topics, none in a 极客班论坛 build; or every topic of the dev snapshot), read from the runtime config so a site build does not bundle the seed topics; the post stream is unchanged. Pin, close, the reply composer and the view count go through useForumActions (the forum server counts one view per address and hour); a guest of 极客班论坛 may open the composer on an open topic; the composer reports the new post id (against the forum server first the pending id it shows under, then the server's) and is bound with v-model:reply-to, so a refused reply goes back to the post it answered (#145). The pin and close toasts follow the topic as it now shows, at once against the forum server (#145).
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/bookmarks.vue: The empty state for someone without a forum user is SignInState (demo: pick an identity as before; 极客班论坛: 用 GitHub 登录, or the service-down note; snapshot: not open yet). Removing a bookmark goes through useForumActions; its toast shows at once, and against the forum server a refusal puts the bookmark back (#145).
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/new.vue: The empty state for someone who may not post follows useCurrentUser().access: the demo keeps 登录后才能发布话题; 极客班论坛 says 登录后才能发帖 with a 用 GitHub 登录 button (guests can still reply in topics), or, from data/access.ts UNAVAILABLE_COPY, 论坛服务暂时连不上 / 请求太频繁，稍后再试 / 这个账号现在不能在论坛里发帖 (signed in, served as a guest); the snapshot says posting is not open yet. Creating a topic goes through useForumActions and waits for the forum server's topic id; against the server the form also checks its limits (title ≤120, ≤5 tags, body ≤20000). The body is written in PostEditor instead of TxMarkdownEditor (编辑 / 分栏 / 预览, the preview through ForumMarkdown). Demo validation unchanged.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/notifications.vue: The empty state for someone without a forum user is SignInState (demo: pick an identity as before; 极客班论坛: 用 GitHub 登录, or the service-down note; snapshot: not open yet).
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/pages/u/[username]/preferences.vue: The empty state for someone without a forum user is SignInState (demo: pick an identity as before; 极客班论坛: 用 GitHub 登录; snapshot: not open yet). The fields read 昵称 and 个人签名. Against the forum server the page is 账号资料: saving checks the server's limits (昵称 ≤30, 签名 ≤200, 所在地 ≤60, 个人网站 https:// ≤200) and PATCHes /api/forum/me/profile (against the forum server the new fields show at once and 资料已保存 waits for the server, #145; the nickname is checked and sent only when it changed, so a GitHub login longer than 30 does not block saving the rest; the field hint lists the characters the server accepts), the signature is a TxInput textarea in the TxBlockInput control slot (line breaks are kept; the demo keeps the one-line field the CDP suite fills), and the 头像 tab picks a PNG/JPEG/WebP of at most 2MB with TxFileUploader (kept out of its file list, whose remove button renders no icon; the page shows the preview as a data: URL because the site CSP allows no blob: images, plus 不用这张), uploads it or restores the GitHub avatar, instead of the demo's initials colour. The demo keeps the colour picker and its store update. The bio placeholder is a 极客班 example (比如：计科 2024 级，在学前端) instead of the upstream CoreBox one, so a 极客班论坛 build carries no upstream sample posts, users or notifications (upstream copy that only the demo branches reach still ships in the bundle, unreachable at runtime).
modifiedUpstreamFiles.scripts/verify-shell.mjs: Follows #62: the header marker is the 极客班 logo image (loaded, alt="") instead of .tx-tuff-logo-stroke, also on the 404 page; the sidebar must start at 筛选侧栏 with no card rows; the demo user menu lists 「@talex · 管理员」 first; after logout the sidebar has no 登录 button or card; after switching to Mika the signed-in 「@mika · 版主」 is read from the header avatar menu instead of the removed sidebar footer card; /about counts only its staff card items.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/stores/forum.ts: The initial state (and reset) is siteForumState() in a 极客班论坛 build and the demo seed otherwise, chosen by the build-time constant import.meta.env.GEEK_FORUM_SITE (nuxt.config.ts vite.define), so the site bundle drops createSeed and the demo content; the vitest suites leave it undefined and keep the seed. Every store operation is unchanged; applyChanges merges a forum server write's answer into the state in place and removeRecords takes out the pending reply the server store showed (#145).
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/NotificationList.vue: The system notification names the site from the content source (「来自 Tuff Forum 的系统消息」 on the demo seed, 「来自极客班论坛的系统消息」 otherwise) instead of the hard-coded Tuff Forum (spacing from shared/content-source.ts siteNameInText). Marking read goes through useForumActions (the forum server in a site build, the store otherwise); an already-read row is not marked again.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/TopicList.vue: When the forum has no topic at all (a fresh 极客班论坛) the empty state says 还没有话题 / 极客班成员登录后可以发第一个话题。 instead of the filter-miss 没有话题 / 换个筛选条件试试, which is unchanged whenever topics exist.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/components/ReplyComposer.vue: Posting goes through useForumActions and emits the new post id; against the forum server the drawer closes and the reply shows under a pending id at once (#145) and 回复已发布 waits for the server. A refused reply is kept in the server store (refusedReplies) with the post it answered and comes back into the drawer in front of whatever the drawer holds by then (a blank line between; several refused replies all come back), the drawer reopens and emits update:replyTo with that post; a reply refused after the topic page was left comes back when that topic's composer is mounted again. The text is written in PostEditor instead of TxMarkdownEditor (编辑 / 分栏 / 预览, the preview through ForumMarkdown); the prefilled quote of the post being answered is quoteDraft, put in as written, and the text sent is the draft as typed. The member drawer is 460px tall (was 420) so the mode switch and the 240px textarea fit without scrolling. The drawer keeps its content mounted while closed, so PostEditor gets a new key on every open and every reply starts in 编辑; the draft lives in the composer and is kept. In 极客班论坛 someone who is not signed in replies as a guest: a 昵称 TxInput joins the drawer (its note lists the characters the server accepts, NAME_CHARS_HINT), the text is capped at guestPolicy.contentMax (members at 20000), and the server store computes the proof of work over the exact text right before sending; the submit button reads 以游客身份回复. When the server has Turnstile configured (guestPolicy.turnstileSiteKey), TurnstileBox renders the check under the editor and its single-use token goes with the reply; every send renders a fresh widget. The demo composer is unchanged (same 回复 button and behaviour).
modifiedUpstreamFiles.app/composables/useCurrentUser.ts: Against the forum server the permission checks pass the server's viewer.capabilities (can(user, action, ctx, granted)), and every check also requires access.writable (app/data/access.ts: false while the server is loading or unreachable). Adds access and guestCanReply(topic) for the 极客班论坛 guest reply. The demo is unchanged (no granted set, always writable).
modifiedUpstreamFiles.scripts/smoke-routes.mjs: The reset-lifecycle check finds the like button by its text (「赞」 or 「赞 N」, #143) instead of button[aria-label="赞"]: the button no longer carries an aria-label, its visible text is its name. /new marks PostEditor (its textarea and three mode radios) instead of .tx-markdown-editor. With TxMarkdownEditor's toolbar gone, the run-level i-ri-* control (still at least 3 painted classes) counts PostEditor's mode icons; the i-carbon-chevron pair from TxPagination remains the tuffex-internal safelist control. Original assertions otherwise intact.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.scripts/verify-topic-page.mjs: The post stream finds the like button by its text (「赞」 or 「赞 N」, #143) instead of button[aria-label="赞"]; the like step reads the count out of 「赞 N」, requires the text to be exactly 「赞 N」 after liking, and checks aria-pressed true after the like and false after the second click. The guest step clicks the same button. It also types into and reads PostEditor's textarea ([data-post-editor] .tx-textarea__field) where it used TxMarkdownEditor's source textarea; the editor assertions are unchanged.
modifiedUpstreamFiles.scripts/verify-user-pages.mjs: Types into PostEditor's textarea ([data-post-editor] .tx-textarea__field) where it used TxMarkdownEditor's source textarea; the assertions are unchanged.
